List and show recorded agent sessions from .wombo-combo/replays/

Every daemon-run agent execution is recorded (prompt, tool calls, outputs, timing and the final worktree diff) as one JSONL file per execution under .wombo-combo/replays/&lt;feature-id&gt;/. Use 'list' to see recorded executions and 'show &lt;feature-id&gt;' to print one session (--execution N, 1-based oldest first, or an execution ID; default latest). Replay a session interactively from the task browser with the p key.

Aliases: `rp`

```sh
woco replay <subcommand> [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
